newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb defused in French post office.
newsitem.headline: Bomb defused in French post office.

text.p: Police defused a three- kg (6.6 lb) bomb in a busy central post office in the French Mediterranean port of Marseille on Saturday, police said.
They said the bomb was hidden in a plastic bag. The area was cordoned off.

A police source said that the attackers "clearly wanted to kill" by planting a bomb in a post office during the Christmas period, when post offices are crowded by people mailing gift parcels and greeting cards.
Authorities have stepped up security under the so-called Vigipirate plan after a bomb attack killed four people on a Paris commuter train earlier this month.

Algerian Moslem extremists were suspected of carrying out the Paris bomb attack. Corsican separatists have also threatened attacks on the French mainland following the arrest of one of their leaders last week.
